hero.title: Vehicles with a driver, for every size of party
hero.body: From a quiet car for two to a coach for a wedding party. Every vehicle comes with a licensed driver who knows the roads, and a quote within a day.
hero.alt: A Travedise jeep on the red road south

intro.heading: Choose by the size of your party.
intro.body: Seven classes of vehicle, each with its own driver. Tell us how many of you there are and we will show what fits.
intro.empty: No single vehicle seats that many. Ask us for two or more.

hires.heading: Four ways to hire.
hires.body: Every hire comes with a driver. Most travellers book one of these, and many combine two.

items.title: Airport transfers
items.body: Met in arrivals with your name on a board, any hour of the day or night, at a fixed price.

items.title: Multi-day tours
items.body: The same chauffeur-guide for your whole journey, with their meals and rooms included in the quote.

items.title: Day hire
items.body: A car and driver for a day trip, a day in Colombo, or a run between two stays.

items.title: Events and weddings
items.body: Guest arrivals, shuttles between hotels and venues, and the car that takes the couple away.

items.title: Tell us the plan
items.body: The vehicle, the dates, where you start and finish, and how many of you are travelling.

items.title: We reply within a day
items.body: With a fixed price that includes the driver, fuel, tolls and parking, and anything we need to check.

items.title: Confirm and travel
items.body: We confirm the booking and send your driver's name and number before you arrive.

questions.a: We only hire vehicles with a driver. Sri Lanka's roads are busy and the rules are local, and a good driver also knows where to stop.
The vehicle, the driver, fuel, tolls and parking. On multi-day hires, the driver's meals and rooms are included too. Park entry and your own meals are not.
Yes. A wedding might use a coach for guests, an SUV for the couple and vans for the families. We plan them as one booking.
Yes. Every driver is licensed, speaks English and works for us.

questions.q: How far ahead should we book?
questions.a: A few days is enough for a car or a van out of season. For December to March, coaches and wedding dates, book as early as you can.

form.heading: Ask for a vehicle quote.
form.body: Two short steps. We reply within a day with a fixed price.

stepOne.title: Tell us about the hire.
stepOne.body: Share what you know. Dates and places can change.

stepTwo.title: How can we reach you?
stepTwo.body: We will use these details to reply to this enquiry, nothing else.

sent.title: Thank you. We will be in touch within a day.
sent.body: Your enquiry is with us and a copy is on its way to your inbox. We will reply with a quote, or a question or two first.

fields.label: Pick-up
fields.placeholder: e.g. Colombo airport, or your hotel

fields.label: Anything else we should know?
fields.placeholder: Flight numbers, child seats, surfboards, stops along the way.
